title: Illustrative community mandate: evidence must settle the question

authority.name: Example only. Not adopted by any community, council or agency.
authority.process: Shows the shape of a decision a community body could make after deliberation.

rationale.reading: A ratio counts only when its 90% interval settles which side of 0.80 it is on.
rationale.familywise: An audit with many groups should not fail, or pass, by chance.
rationale.small_category_exclusion: No group is dropped at the auditor's discretion; small groups are where harm is hardest to see.
rationale.indeterminate_is: When the data cannot settle the question, the audit does not certify compliance. The company must collect more evidence.
rationale.accept_test_data: Compliance must be shown on real applicants, not data the company generated or selected.
